title: User groups
subtitle: Manage concurrency limits, token quotas and model access per group
emptyHint: Create a group to set concurrency limits, token quota and allowed model groups.

form.nameExtra: Must be unique across the gateway
form.nameMax: Name must be at most 64 characters
form.maxConcurrencyExtra: 0–100000; 0 means unlimited and inherits the gateway-wide limit
form.keyMaxConcurrencyExtra: 0–100000; must be ≤ the group limit when set; 0 inherits the group limit
form.keyExceedsGroup: Per-key concurrency cannot exceed the group concurrency
form.tokenQuotaExtra: 0 means unlimited; counted per calendar month, requests are rate-limited once exceeded
form.modelGroupsExtra: Select 1–100 groups; leave empty to allow every model
form.modelGroupsPlaceholder: Leave empty to allow all models
form.enabledExtra: When disabled, members fall back to the default group; changes take effect immediately
form.noteMax: Note must be at most 255 characters
form.tokensPerMinuteExtra: 0 = unlimited; trailing 60 seconds of actual consumption, 429 with Retry-After when exceeded
